description: Black Friday 2026 VPS deals of providers we track, each with the stated price, the monthly price as stated for its term (a renewal price is never estimated), the lowest price we recorded for the same plan in the 30 days before the sealed moment (Fri 20 Nov 2026 11:00 UTC; fewer days where our history is shorter, see n_days and low_coverage), the difference between the two (difference_vs_lowest_30d, negative = below it) and links to the proof (archived observation, SKU history, sealed manifest). Facts only: where a comparison is not safe (other currency, VAT basis not stated, deal already in force, plan not in our history) it is null with its reason. `headline` counts, of the deals checked, how many were below the lowest price we recorded in the 30 days before the seal and how many were at or above it, with the as-of time. Each deal has a permanent page (links.permalink). Empty until providers publish deals.
